publication.head: codex/5597-generation-aware-preparation-safe
publication.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Make issue preparation generation-aware and lossless
publication.body:
Closes #5597

Repairs typed C-SDLC v2 issue preparation so native compact 1.0.0 cards and legacy/import 1.0.3 cards resolve through explicit generation-aware registry authority. Bootstrap and migration preserve operator constraints and review scope, phase-safe typed SIP/STP/SRP edits are available, acceptance coverage updates atomically, and review assignment synchronizes SRP truth.

The implementation removes public low-level bootstrap bypasses, validates registry and manifest paths against the repository authority root, preserves immutable Gate 9 observations, and keeps v1 sunset authority intact.

Validation passed at substantive revision 0edf30b56f4d4c0e2dad35055b7fd5f5deb6fe48: complete all-target tests and doctests, focused Gate 5/Gate 7/Gate 10A suites, strict all-target Clippy, formatting, bounded revision scope, stable owner-binary provenance, and typed doctor. Two independent exact-revision reviews found no remaining findings. No AWS or raw gh was used.
